meta.note: Demo marketing dataset for the Go Vita member-support workflow. All assets are self-contained SVGs under docs/assets/marketing/ and are free for members to use in-store, online, and with customers.
meta.contactRoute: Members ask Alice (member support); marketing enquiries are routed to Cindy.

brandGuidelines.tagline: More than a health food shop. A turning point towards wellness.
brandGuidelines.voice: Warm, knowledgeable, encouraging, never preachy. Plain-English health advice.

colours.name: Go Vita Red
colours.use: Primary brand colour, logos, headlines, CTAs

logoRules: Maintain clear space equal to the height of the leaf mark on all sides.
Use the reverse (white) logo on dark or photographic backgrounds.
Do not stretch, recolour, or add effects to the logo.
Minimum width 120px on screen / 30mm in print.
brandGuidelines.fonts: Headlines: heavy sans-serif (Segoe UI / Helvetica / Arial 800). Body: regular sans-serif.

testimonials.quote: The seasonal poster kits make our window look professional in minutes — we swap them every quarter.
Shelf talkers lift our staff-pick sales noticeably. Customers trust the recommendation.
Having the logos and social tiles ready to download saves us hours every week.

testimonials.quote: Go Mag is still our best in-store conversation starter. Members come in asking for the specials.

faq.q: Can I get the Go Vita logo for my store signage?
faq.a: Yes — primary (colour) and reverse (white) logos are available as scalable SVGs. See the Logos section.

faq.q: Do you have current promotional posters?
faq.a: Yes — seasonal window posters and web banners are kept current per campaign (New Year Detox, Winter Wellness, Spring Reset).

faq.q: What can I post on social media?
faq.a: Ready-made square social tiles with the #GoVitaWellness hashtag; pair with your own product photos.

faq.q: How do members earn marketing support?
faq.a: All co-op members can request any asset in this catalogue free of charge via member support (Alice).
